gen.title: Core Principles and Aerodynamic Forces Review

cards.stem: Which listed fundamental states the relation between work, force and distance?
cards.hint: Think of the basic definition linking effort and displacement.

cards.stem: Which fundamental describes the basic rules governing motion for flight study?
cards.hint: Covers three classic laws taught as core fundamentals.

cards.stem: Which lesson topic groups the forces that act on an aircraft in flight?
cards.hint: Look for the general category that includes lift, drag and related effects.

cards.stem: Which aerodynamics lesson explains the link between pressure and velocity in flow?
cards.hint: Often used to describe how speed changes affect pressure.
